releases.name: pi 1.12.1
releases.body:
### Fixed

#### Plans

- A plan item named as the plan view lists it, `<content> (<ticket or ref>)`, is that item for every op.
  - `init` and `append` drop that suffix, and a ticket item's own ref repeated after its action, so an item copied from the view keeps its content and shows its ticket once.
  - The stop reminder lists open items the same way, followed by their status.

#### Inbox and attention

- A request sent while an earlier inbox read was still answering shows in that turn's `<kata_inbox>` section, not only on the next turn.

releases.name: kata-cc 1.0.0 (Claude Code)
releases.body:
### Added

#### Requirements

- Tested with Claude Code 2.1.326 and Kata 0.23.0. The mod API is early access, so a later Claude Code release can need a plugin update.

#### Install and update

- The `kata-cc` plugin installs from the repository's marketplace with `/plugin install kata-cc --marketplace Dangerboi/kata-plugin`, or `claude plugin install kata-cc@kata-plugin` from a shell. It has no npm package: updates come from `claude plugin marketplace update kata-plugin` and `claude plugin update kata-cc@kata-plugin`, and reach an installed copy when the plugin's version moves.
  - To replace the earlier Claude Code adapter, `kata@kata-plugin` 0.2.0, run `claude plugin uninstall kata@kata-plugin`, then `claude plugin marketplace update kata-plugin` and `claude plugin install kata-cc@kata-plugin`. With both installed, a delegate's work is recorded twice.
- The options `liveInbox`, `contract`, `kataExecutable` and `debugFile` are declared by the plugin and set with `/plugin configure` or `--config KEY=VALUE`, each with an environment variable where there is one (`KATA_CLAUDE_LIVE_INBOX`, `KATA_CLAUDE_EXECUTABLE`, `KATA_CLAUDE_DEBUG`). Claude Code prints `4 userConfig options not yet set` after an install; nothing has to be set.

#### Plans

- A Kata-backed `todo` tool replaces `TaskCreate`, `TaskGet`, `TaskList`, `TaskUpdate` and `TodoWrite`, with the same ops, ticket items and closing rules as omp. Each prompt carries the plan, and every close records the lead's session.
  - A `kata close` the lead or a delegate runs in `Bash` records it too, and keeps the permission an allow rule such as `Bash(kata *)` gives the command the model wrote.
  - A session's plan survives `/resume`, `/clear` and `/branch`, and what a session left owing is finished when it is resumed. The session end has 1.5 s, so work that does not fit waits for the resume.
  - A session that ends with a task still open keeps its saved plan for `claude --resume`, whether its parent is automatic or explicit, its items are tickets or the plan is session-local. A fork made in the session starts with its source's plan; `claude --resume <id> --fork-session` names no source to the plugin and starts from a plan of its own.
  - Kata's contract, inbox and session attention come from `kata agent-hook install claude`; the plugin adds the contract only with `contract` on.

#### Delegates

- `Agent` subagents, Workflow agents and teammates take the plan item or ticket their task names as their assignment, and their `kata` commands in `Bash` run under their own teammate. Under auto permission mode the plugin denies such a command with the exact command to run, because Claude Code refuses a rewrite there.
  - Code Review workflows and a Workflow agent's stall retries are untracked.
  - The waits for an assignment share the spawn hook's 10 s, so a slow Kata starts the agent without its assignment instead of overrunning the hook.

#### Inbox and attention

- The main session follows the session inbox live and delivers each request without waiting for a prompt; one that arrives in a turn's final step rides the next turn. Either `liveInbox` off or `KATA_CLAUDE_LIVE_INBOX=0` turns it off.

#### Display

- The plan band above the prompt, a checklist card under each of the lead's `todo` calls, `#` ticket completion and `/todo` show the plan in the terminal UI.
  - The card shows the result's notice (a deleted parent, a close Kata deferred). A session-local plan draws no band and no card.
  - A loaded ticket list answers `#` completion at once; only the first fill waits, 400 ms at most.

#### Development

- `bun run validate:claude` and `bun run test:claude` run `claude plugin validate` and `claude plugin test`, and `bun run smoke:claude` runs a real headless `claude -p` on haiku against a throwaway Kata store. The smoke run needs a Claude Code login and is paid; none of them runs in CI.

releases.name: omp 2.12.1
releases.body:
### Fixed

#### Plans

- A plan item named as the plan view lists it, `<content> (<ticket or ref>)`, is that item for every op.
  - `init` and `append` drop that suffix, and a ticket item's own ref repeated after its action, so an item copied from the view keeps its content and shows its ticket once.
  - The stop reminder lists open items the same way, followed by their status.

#### Delegates

- A `task` call that names a ticket goes ahead while Kata cannot be reached, and its delegate's assignment is retried on its next use, instead of the call being refused with Kata's error.

#### Inbox and attention

- A request sent while an earlier inbox read was still answering shows in that turn's `<kata_inbox>` section, not only on the next turn.

releases.name: OpenCode 1.2.0
releases.body:
@dangerboi/kata-opencode 1.2.0. It also ships the shared changes listed under 1.12.0: session holds that survive a deferred close and a normal end, delegates decided by one rule with their outages retried, a throttled mission saved at once, blank evidence left out of closes, and `init` refusing `takeover`.

### Changed

#### Plans

- OpenCode: deleting or archiving a session releases the items it started at once, as omp and pi do when a session ends. Only an item whose close Kata deferred keeps its holder, so the retry still closes it.
- OpenCode: one `todowrite` call runs as one job, so a delegate event or retry timer no longer runs between its steps, and one session waiting on Kata no longer delays another session's turn end, delegate exits or deletion.

#### Delegates

- **Breaking:** OpenCode: delegate records that ended with an issue are kept with the lead's saved state instead of a separate storage entry, so a follow-up to a delegate that ended before the upgrade starts a new, untracked record. Send such follow-ups before upgrading, or name the item again in a new `subagent` call.

### Fixed

#### Plans

- OpenCode: `todowrite` advice speaks `todowrite`'s words.
  - A session OpenCode cannot read is told so, instead of being called a delegate.
  - A first list under a `ref` that leaves out the issue's open items is told to send them, not to pass `replace: true`.
  - The refusals for a delegated task and for held tasks left out of an `init` no longer name ops `todowrite` does not have.
- OpenCode: a session deleted or archived with work left is finished as soon as that work is done, without a restart; one deleted while no instance of its folder ran is ended by the next setup; and a saved session is no longer picked up after the plugin stopped.

#### Delegates

- OpenCode: a subagent is bound to the call whose prompt is its first message, not to an earlier call whose prompt that message merely ends with.
- OpenCode: a `subagent` call that another plugin's hook refuses, or whose background child never starts, frees its plan item at the end of the lead's turn instead of leaving it "already delegated".
- OpenCode: a late end event of a delegate's earlier run no longer ends its follow-up run; a delegate whose session is gone at its end event still exits, and one whose own session is deleted or archived exits as aborted.
- OpenCode: Kata commands in `shell` from a child session the lead does not track run under a teammate derived from the session, and `--as` is refused. Before, they ran as the lead.
- OpenCode: a failed storage or session read in a hook no longer fails a child session's tool calls.
- OpenCode: archiving or deleting a lead frees the plan items its pending `subagent` calls held, so they can be delegated again after an unarchive.
